hook: Born in Los Angeles? Saju still reads the city.
script: Saju is a Korean way of reading a birth date as four pillars.
The date and time go in first, then Los Angeles as the birth city.
The app works out the pillars and lands on one of fifty types.
Free to try. Link in bio.
caption:
Korean saju, with a birth city outside Korea.
Free saju type card from a birth date: link in bio.
Self-reflection tool, not medical or psychological advice.
